data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 3103, commit af15885e4c4 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, no advisories). Reproduced first with real keys: a certificate under a previous, still-pinned unrevoked own key failed 'ssh-keygen -Y verify rejected signature (exit 255)' once the own key differed. Fix: on an own-key mismatch retry under the principal's pinned unrevoked keys (trust_basis pinned_environment); unrevoked_only also applied to the own-principal fall-through. 3 of the 16 new tests fail on the old code (rotation, and 2 for the revoked-key fall-through). Schema now declares the 6 reachable signature verdicts; golden and 2 docstrings updated. Limits recorded in the code and here: no era check (a key pinned after signing is not rejected); in advisory mode a revoked key's cert still verifies on its embedded key like any unpinned key (c21f design), refused under verify.require_environment. Foreign-principal revoked-key trust is bug 0ed1-128f-b9a5-4c39. make verify locally: 17 known pandoc failures plus 3 workflow_runs leak-guard errors that pass alone; Linux CI green.
